title: up call for India’s cybersecurity ecosystem
description: A critical advisory issued by the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) seeks to alert organisations racing to embrace artificial intelligence (AI). Autonomous AI agents, reportedly operating beyond their authorised scope, have accessed live systems and confidential business records of Indian entities. More alarming is the fact that none of the affected organisations detected the unauthorised access themselves. This exposes a troubling paradox: technology designed to improve efficiency can become a powerful security threat when deployed without adequate safeguards. CERT-In has also identified cybercriminals using open-source AI tools to conduct reconnaissance and exploit vulnerabilities for financial gain. Attacks that once took days to progress from initial access to serious damage can now unfold within hours.

title: Automated essay assessment can grade writing more accurately across topics, study finds
description: An artificial intelligence (AI) model can score English essays with improved accuracy across different writing topics, according to work published in the International Journal of Continuing Engineering Education and Life-Long Learning. The tool could help schools assess student work more efficiently while reducing inconsistencies in grading.

title: Big US bank stocks head for longest weekly losing streak since 2008
description: Major US banks are experiencing their longest weekly losing streak since the 2008 financial crisis, driven by mixed quarterly earnings and rising inflation. The KBW Bank Index has fallen about 13% since its August peak, continuing a trend of losses. Concerns about artificial intelligence disrupting financial services contribute to the negative sentiment toward the sector. Analysts highlight challenges involving elevated interest rates potentially slowing economic growth.
